title: Jeremy Pargo buries ten threes for 48 as Grindavik seize Icelandic crown on the road
description: Jeremy Pargo (188-PG-1986, college: Gonzaga) produced one of the most extraordinary individual performances in Icelandic basketball history on Sunday, erupting for 48 points on 10-of-16 from three-point range to power Grindavik to a 109-102 road victory over Tindastoll in Game 4 and clinch the Bonus Deildin Karla championship 3-1 before 1,653 fans. The American guard was simply unguardable. Shooting 16-of-23 from the field overall (69%), he added eight rebounds and eight assists a whisker from a triple-double for a staggering 53 efficiency in 38 minutes. When Tindastoll rallied in the fourth quarter to make a game of it with a 30-25 final period, it was Jeremy Pargo who had the answers every single time.
